✓ Hispanics in the United States Coast G.question: The first _____ to command a TACLET (Tactical Law Enforcement Team), was then-Lieutenant Jose L. Rodriguez when he took command of TACLET South, 1996–1998
✓ Hispanics in the United States Coast G.fact: In 1991, LTJG Katherine Tiongson became the first Hispanic-American woman to command an afloat unit when she took command of USCGC Bainbridge Island. She was also the first Hispanic-American woman intelligence officer in the Coast Guard.

✓ Hispanics in the United States Coast G.question: In March 2007, he led the _____ crew in the largest maritime drug bust in U.S
✓ Hispanics in the United States Coast G.fact: On July 21, 2005, Captain Charley L. Diaz became the first Hispanic-American to command a high endurance cutter when he assumed command of the USCGC Sherman. In March 2007, he led the Sherman crew in the largest maritime drug bust in U.S.

✓ Hispanics in the United States Coast G.fact: Paul Powers Perez, class of 1945, was the first person born in the United States of Hispanic American descent to graduate from the academy. He was followed by John Gazzo Martinez, class of 1951.
